notes.title: The Cubic Blitz Demo is available now!
notes.notes:
The Cubic Blitz Demo is officially out now! Try it and let me know your thoughts! If you liked it, consider adding it to your Steam wishlist, which would be greatly appreciated! The demo will also be available in the upcoming Steam Next Fest in June.

Any and all feedback is also appreciated, as this lets me know what parts of the game I should work on to deliver the best user experience in the final product. Thank you so much!
